definitions.gloss: Central America; region between Mexico and South America
definitions.explanation: The narrow strip of the American continent linking North and South America, including countries such as Guatemala, Honduras, Costa Rica, and Panama.

examples.english: Coffee is an important product of Central America.

notes:
The land bridge between North and South America, often counted as the southern part of North America.
